items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: And like in Brooklyn when my sister-in-law called me for the Baby Grand in Brooklyn and Nipsey Russell was the emcee.

ctx.x: I like your description of a typical act, the full act in a club would consist of an exotic dancer, the singer and the emcee, and a comedian.

No, the emcee was a comedian, the exotic dancer, the singer and of course the house band. And like in Brooklyn when my sister-in-law called me for the Baby Grand in Brooklyn and Nipsey Russell was the emcee.
